meta_description: Omega Electrical Services in Leicester. NICEIC-registered electrician for rewires, fault-finding, and emergency call-outs. Fast, reliable, fully insured.
hero_subhead: Wiring fault at home? We diagnose and fix electrical problems fast, any day of the week.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to full rewires, we handle every aspect of domestic and commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, burnt-out circuits, tripped RCDs — we're on call 24/7. Most faults diagnosed and repaired same day with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Upgrading an older property or expanding capacity? We plan, quote, and complete rewires with minimal disruption and full compliance with current Building Regulations.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults, flickering lights, or persistent circuit trips? We'll trace the root cause with specialist test equipment and restore safety and reliability.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Board Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuse boxes are a fire risk. We replace them with modern, fully earthed consumer units that protect your home and meet Part P standards.

services.title: Installation of Lighting & Sockets
services.desc: Adding extra sockets, new light fittings, or outdoor electrics? Each installation is certified and tested to guarantee safety and longevity.

services.title: Periodic Inspections & Certificates
services.desc: Landlords and property sellers: we provide EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Reports) with full test schedules and signed certification.

about_pullquote: I started Omega because I hated seeing householders quoted £800 for a £50 fix.
about_para_1: Omega Electrical Services was founded in Leicester eighteen years ago by a journeyman electrician tired of seeing customers overcharged and left without proper advice. From a single van and a reputation for honesty, we've grown to employ four fully NICEIC-registered electricians and a dedicated office team. Every engineer carries a van-load of parts, so we fix most faults on the spot.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we diagnose properly before we quote, we explain the work in plain English, and we turn up when we say we will. We're equally comfortable rewiring a Victorian terrace or troubleshooting a commercial property. Repeat work and referrals make up 60% of our business—that's how you know you've got it right.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a power surge that killed the electrics on half the house. Called Omega on a Saturday afternoon and they were here within ninety minutes. Diagnosed a faulty RCD, fitted a new one and tested the whole circuit. Fair price, no messing about. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed a full rewire and a new board fitted before we could get our mortgage offer. Omega came in, did a clear quote, completed the job in three days, and provided all the certificates we needed. Professional, tidy, and they cleaned up after themselves. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma L.

reviews.text: The cooker wasn't working and I thought it was the oven. Turned out to be a dodgy circuit. Called a couple of other electricians and they quoted £200+ just for the visit. Omega came out, fixed it in twenty minutes, charged me a fair rate. Genuine people.
reviews.author: David P.
